intro: The High Order is an introductory quest on Zephras wherein Rathiril Sunlance explains the plight of the shen'dorei. Having lost the aid of their elemental benefactors, these Highborne descendants of Eldre'Thalas must harness their ancient arcane magic to safeguard their survival.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.
Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The High Order's mission is vital to the survival of our people. We hold our elemental benefactors in the utmost regard, but we must face reality; they are gone now, and we are on our own.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and uncertainties of our security on this plane, it is our destiny as Highborne descendants of our ancestral home of Eldre'Thalas to use our gifts to ensure that the shen'dorei can stand on our own once again.
